title: Pricing
description: Choose the level of homework support your family needs, from guided practice to professional teacher support.
supportLevelBody: Guided practice, parent reports, and professional teacher support stay connected in one family learning path.
valueBody: STOA combines guided homework support, parent-visible learning signals, and teacher support escalation so students can get unstuck while families stay informed.
pilotBody: Start with a free trial, see whether STOA fits your family routine, then choose a plan when ready.
pilotDetail: Each plan makes the student, parent, and teacher support level clear before checkout.

priceStructure.title: Price structure
priceStructure.description: Monthly plans are structured around the access levels explained in Plan access below.
priceStructure.note: Final checkout availability and billing terms are confirmed by STOA before a family starts a paid plan.

plans.name: Free trial
plans.fit: For families validating whether STOA fits their homework routine.
plans.access: Limited question explanations and homework upload, parent dashboard included, no weekly reports or teacher Q&A.

plans.name: Student plan
plans.fit: For one learner who needs steady guided homework support.
plans.access: Question explanations, homework upload, parent dashboard, and weekly reports included; teacher Q&A is not included.

plans.name: Teacher-supported plan
plans.fit: For families who want professional help when homework questions need escalation.
plans.access: Everything in Student, plus limited weekly teacher Q&A.

plans.name: Family plan
plans.fit: For families who want the highest support level and shared access.
plans.access: All core access, 5x teacher Q&A time, and shared benefits for up to 3 people.
